summary: Star Group, L.P. filed a routine Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, furnishing a press release under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing its quarterly cash distribution of $0.1975 per common unit for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30, 2026. The record date is October 26, 2026, with payment on November 4, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is an ordinary distribution declaration by the NYSE-listed home energy distributor, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
